_why: Narration pace per language, measured from the owner's real recordings (seconds of finished audio per SCRIPT word, pauses included). studio/script_check.py turns word counts into minutes with it. Re-measure after every recorded episode: python3 studio/script_check.py NN --calibrate [--lang en]. PACE=<s/word> env still overrides for one run.

hi.source: EP06 owner recording: 478.4 s / 1303 script words (1326 spoken words, 0.361 s/spoken word)
hi.note: 8-10 min at this pace = about 1,310-1,630 Hindi script words (aim 1,390-1,550 = 8.5-9.5 min). The old 0.575 s/word guide-voice pace is retired.

en.source: PROVISIONAL: typical calm documentary narration (~150 words/min). Replace after the first English recording with --calibrate --lang en.
en.note: 8-10 min at this pace = about 1,200-1,500 English words.
